ai_show_review.summary: Extended Scarlet>Fire jam & tight Ship‑Fools/Prophet/Eyes flow
ai_show_review.blurb: The Greek Theatre show delivers a marathon Scarlet Begonias → Fire on the Mountain and a seamless Ship of Fools → Estimated Prophet → Eyes of the World sequence. Brent’s vocal turn on Little Red Rooster and his textured keyboards shine, while the rhythm section drives the high‑energy second set.
ai_show_review.review: What unfolds at the Greek Theatre on May 23 1982 is a showcase of the Dead in full improvisational stride. The first set opens with a solid Shakedown Street that rolls into a breezy Let It Grow, and Brent’s surprising lead vocal on Little Red Rooster adds an extra layer of excitement. The second set is where the night truly ignites: Scarlet Begonias flows straight into a sprawling 33‑minute Fire on the Mountain, a performance often cited as one of the season’s highlights. From there the band rides a flawless wave through Ship of Fools, then stitches Estimated Prophet directly into Eyes of the World, creating a seamless tapestry of melodic exploration and rhythmic drive. The ensuing The Other One → Stella Blue → I Need A Miracle stretch keeps the momentum alive, culminating in a relaxed Casey Jones before an encore that lands on a raucous Satisfaction and a heartfelt Brokedown Palace. Across all available tapes the playing is consistently inspired – Jerry’s lead work is crisp and daring, Brent’s keyboards bloom throughout, and the dual drummers lock into a powerful groove that propels every jam.

best_recording.reason: Pristine sound‑board capture with excellent separation, clean mix, and full band balance – the clearest window onto this high‑energy performance.

key_highlights: 33‑minute Scarlet Begonias → Fire on the Mountain jam that builds from subtle to explosive
Seamless Ship of Fools → Estimated Prophet → Eyes of the World flow with tight interplay
The Other One and Stella Blue sequence delivers powerful drumming and emotive solos
Brent’s vocal lead on Little Red Rooster and his lush keyboard textures throughout

band_performance.Jerry: Solid guitar work throughout, with fiery leads on Scarlet>Fire and lyrical phrasing on the extended jams; relaxed vocal on Casey Jones.
band_performance.Phil: Bass anchors the long improvisations, delivering melodic runs that lift Ship of Fools into Estimated Prophet and drive the Energy of Eyes of the World.
band_performance.Bob: Rhythm/lead guitar sits forward in many mixes, providing funky comping on Shakedown Street and complementary leads during The Other One and Stella Blue.
band_performance.Brent: Harley‑mic’d keyboards add bright texture; standout vocal performance on Little Red Rooster and consistent melodic support across the second set.
band_performance.Mickey: Drum‑space antics shine especially during Scarlet>Fire and the high‑octane moments of The Other One, adding dynamic contrast.
band_performance.Billy: Locks in tight with Mickey, delivering a powerful, steady foundation that propels the band through the marathon jams.
